notes.title: 🔹 Cosmic: A Journey Among Shadows – Update 1.05 is Here! 🌌

notes.title: Patch 1.04 is here! ⚡👻
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KgpemYhLKB0;full][/previewyoutube]

This update brings key improvements to gameplay, balance, and overall experience:

🔹 New Look-Around Mechanic – Now you can peek ahead to spot tricky and dangerous areas! 👀
🔹 Reworked Death Mechanic – Darkflies now appear in Save Cats after respawning, making recovery smoother. 🕊️
🔹 More Save Cats! – We've added extra checkpoints to keep the journey fair yet challenging. 🐱
🔹 Final Boss Enhancements – Tweaks and improvements to make the showdown more intense! ⚔️
🔹 Clearer Light Zones – Light areas now have a much clearer shape, making it easier to see where you can fight and charge. 💡
🔹 Improved Light Charge Feedback – Added a much clearer visual cue when the player's charged light runs out, ensuring better control in combat. 🔥⚡
🔹 Bug Fixes & Optimizations – Squashed plenty of pesky issues for a smoother adventure. 🛠️

Enjoy the journey, and keep the feedback coming! 🖤🔥

notes.title: Cosmic: A Journey Among Shadows - Patch 0.11 🔥
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6GY7fBECa_c;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315357/91ed162ab4c899325843e919d27a7fbf30213206.png[/img]

[b]New features and improvements coming to #cosmicgame with Update 0.11! 🔥[/b]

► Improving the readability of the map
► Fixed an issue causing the Octopus bomb to respawn while the pause menu was activated
► Translations added to the Piece of Lights
► Volumetrics added to existing levels
► Balanced damage value caused by bombs
► Fixed an issue causing all skills to be lost when players returned to early levels
► Fixed a bug where the Shield power-up was not causing damage to the Octopus boss
► Added randomness to the animations of Ground Wave enemy
► Fixed an issue that caused the map indicators to not hide after completing a task
► Fixed an issue in some places where the player could jump out of the level
► Fixed an issue in the Darkflies counter that changed position when collecting more Darkflies in a short period of time
► Added translations of the districts on the world map
and a lot of more smaller bugs fixed!
